annotations.title: China TWOV A-B-C Third-Country / Region Routing Validator

description: Validate whether a flight routing (Origin Country/Region A -> Mainland China B -> Destination Country/Region C, including Hong Kong, Macau, or Taiwan) satisfies strict NIA TWOV third-region rules vs round-trip disqualification.

inboundFrom.description: Country or region of the last stop immediately before entering Mainland China (e.g. "South Korea", "United States", "Hong Kong")

outboundTo.description: Country or region of the first stop immediately after departing Mainland China (e.g. "Hong Kong", "Japan", "Thailand")

name: validate_third_country_itinerary_rule
